newsitem.title: USA: CME lumber futures end higher in light trade.
newsitem.headline: CME lumber futures end higher in light trade.

text.p: CME lumber futures finished higher after ranging on both sides of previous levels early in light pre-weekend dealings, traders said.

Profit taking weighed on prices after an initial carryover bulge, but prices drifted back to the plus side on scattered support and moved up to day's highs late on demand prompted by ideas of firmer cash markets after the holidays, traders said.

Random Lengths quoted cash spruce at $392 per cwt, unchanged from last week. Trade activity was slow due to the holidays but mills held asking prices on expectations of increased demand into the new year, they said.
Lumber futures closed $5.60 to $1.00 per tbf higher with January up $2.00 at $404.70 and March up most at $397.30 per tbf.
